seo.description: A portfolio built as a store, with real booking on Google Calendar.

gallery.title: Everything is static except the store in the browser and the booking server behind it.
gallery.desc: Illustration: a browser window showing a store of project cards, two added to the cart, and the cart drawer open with those two projects, a picked time slot, a $0.00 total and a book a call button.
gallery.caption: Everything is static except the store in the browser and the booking server behind it.

sections.label: How it’s built
sections.html:
No framework runtime and no third-party widgets: static Astro pages with one interactive island. The store’s state is a pure, unit-tested reducer in plain TypeScript, and the cart lives in the URL, so a cart can be shared as a link.

Checkout books a real call: a small Cloudflare Worker reads my Google Calendar free/busy and sends the invite with a Meet link. Everything renders as plain HTML first, so the site works without JavaScript and prints as a résumé.

sections.label: Two designs
sections.html: The same markup carries two designs. A theme layer of design tokens and component rules switches the whole site to a 1990s version with a CRT-style transition, remembers the choice, and never prints.

sections.label: Scores
sections.html:
Lighthouse mobile scores 100 for accessibility and best practices on every page; performance is 96–97 on project pages and about 70 on the landing page. axe finds no WCAG 2.2 AA violations in any state.
